import openpyxl, os

input_path = '/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/130-9__1_130-9_init/1_130-9_init.xlsx'

ws = wb['b2b, sez, de']
src = wb['cdnr']

for r in range(5, src.max_row + 1):

for i, sr in enumerate(source_rows):
    dr = start_row + i

    # Direct column copies where source and destination positions match.
